concept.description: Represents a physical EV charging point managed by the Mobility domain.
concept.selection_guidance: Select the integrations and devices that expose the charging point and its technical data.

domain_presentation.selection_guidance: Configure each Mobility concept by selecting the integrations and devices that provide its technical data or control surfaces.
